supervision: semi_supervised; dense TRAIN subset incl audit; not no-GT
teacher: EMA of labeled-initialized student; updated after final commit only
audit: TRAIN optimization data; one-v-rest Brier incl negatives; not a generalization certificate
guard: extra pseudo displacement only; no hidden AdamW transformation

diagnostics.prediction_policy: image_only; freeze both diagnostics before GT scoring
diagnostics.gate_policy: D2 must improve native foreground Dice over both D0 and D1 under prelocked criteria; never launches R

compact.teacher: fixed verified full-EMA-run teacher; state explicitly pinned
compact.quality_metric: historical frame -> patient/class -> class patient mean -> Macro4

server_supervised_runner.batch_policy: profile 8/32/64; lock one 32 or 64 for matched arms
server_supervised_runner.selection: VAL Macro4, earliest checkpoint on exact tie; TEST only after best freeze
server_supervised_runner.backup: actual payload copy and remote streamed SHA256 verification; retain local on failure

server_campaign.execution: finite sequential queue on one GPU; adopt existing S0 by process identity
server_campaign.teacher: one separately pinned full-EMA B8 reproduction; retain historical B8 recipe
server_campaign.kd_gate: new B8 raw student, verified payload/lineage/Drive readback, TEST50 Macro4 >= 0.87
server_campaign.joint_supervised: random initialization; ACDC4+MNM4; equal-domain VAL selection; independent of teacher
server_campaign.resume: explicit exact checkpoint hash; no automatic fresh restart
